{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 6:15). Nobody spoke and no hands were shown on the table, so I have no new evidence on any individual. I still can't say who placed which domino, so I'm crediting no one with specific placements.

Table state: the chain is closed and dark all the way round from the start, with no visible break. The one pale stray is still at about (20.3, 7.8) by the dip on the top line. It looks detached, so it is probably harmless unless it gets knocked into the line. The belly at x 23-26, y about 13, still looks crowded or doubled, with a tight cluster near x 24. That is the likeliest weak point or odd spot in the fall. Everyone seems to have stopped touching, so I expect both to stay as they are.

SOFIA: Not seen this visit. Earlier evidence still stands: a clear plan, good coordination, and a commitment to inspect the join. I haven't confirmed she inspected it or dealt with the crowded belly. Strong collaboration so far. Impact and execution are still unverified by me.

OMAR: Not seen. Earlier he showed good ownership and communication. The pale stray is still unremoved, so the cleanup was not finished. I don't know whether he chose to leave it. Ask him.

HANA: Not seen. Her earlier hands-off call was sensible and team-minded. Jack says she built the tail, but I haven't verified that. Ask her what she built.

JACK: Not seen. He gave generous credit to teammates and followed the hands-off call. His praise isn't evidence of his own work. Ask him privately what he did.

NEXT: Watch the fall test, especially the dip and the belly at x 23-26. Ask Hana and Jack privately what they built. Ask Sofia whether she checked the join and the belly."}
